rows.description: Another girl whispers that my best friend now finds me boring, hoping to split us. Wise: check directly with my friend rather than trust the whisperer. Believing everything I hear lets others steer my friendships.
graph_context: same situation, other stances at this age: acceptance, comfort, fear, guilt, insecurity, jealousy

rows.description: I dread the bus and my stomach hurts on school mornings. Fear is a sensible signal, not weakness. Wise: tell a trusted adult and note what happens. Hiding it because of shame keeps the bully in charge.
graph_context: same situation, other stances at this age: anger, contempt, hatred, loneliness, loyalty, mockery
related mind states: fear, shame, trust, hurt

rows.description: I feel there must be something wrong with me for being picked on. It is not my fault; bullies pick targets because of their own needs. Telling a parent or teacher lifts the weight I carry alone.
graph_context: same situation, other stances at this age: anger, contempt, fear, hatred, loneliness, loyalty
related mind states: shame

rows.description: I want to hit back so he stops. Anger is understandable, but fighting can get me punished and hurt. Wise: walk away, stay near friends, report it. Plotting revenge keeps me tied to him.
graph_context: same situation, other stances at this age: contempt, fear, hatred, loneliness, loyalty, mockery
related mind states: anger, hurt

rows.description: A bigger boy calls me names and laughs whenever I speak. He wants a reaction and an audience. I do not owe him one; I keep my dignity, move away and tell an adult. His words are not the truth about me.
graph_context: same situation, other stances at this age: anger, fear, hatred, loneliness, loyalty, mockery

rows.description: I am scared but I tell my class teacher what has been happening. A good teacher listens, believes me and acts without making me look like a snitch. Telling is not tale-telling when someone is being hurt.
graph_context: same situation, other stances at this age: anger, contempt, fear, hatred, loneliness, loyalty
related mind states: fear, trust, hurt

rows.description: My father wants to storm into school after I confess. Wise parents listen first, thank me for telling, and plan together with the school. Being told just fight back or stop being sensitive teaches me to stay silent.
graph_context: same situation, other stances at this age: anger, contempt, fear, hatred, loneliness, loyalty

rows.description: A friend stands next to me when the bully arrives and walks to class with me. Small loyalty makes me feel less alone. I thank her and we agree to stay together and report it.

rows.description: I wonder why he is so mean and guess maybe he is hurt at home. Understanding a reason is not the same as excusing it. I can feel some pity and still keep away and ask adults for help.
graph_context: same situation, other stances at this age: anger, contempt, fear, hatred, loneliness, loyalty

rows.description: I hate him so much that I think about it all day. Hatred is a heavy load that hurts me more. Wise: talk to someone, keep busy with things I love, and let adults handle him. Revenge fantasies are natural but not a plan.
